post.youtube_description:
A phone charging under a pillow can't get rid of its heat, and a damaged lithium battery can go into thermal runaway and catch fire without warning. If a device is smoking, don't touch it: get out, close the door and call 112 from outside. Charge on a hard surface with the original charger, and not while you sleep.
